units.source_text: 然而，他把颜料盒盖上之后，还是不想去移动一下那副三脚架。

en.t: However, even after he closed the paint box, he still did not feel like moving that tripod at all.

units.source_text: 这是一座架设在溪流上的桥，红漆都剥落了。

en.t: It was a bridge built over a mountain stream, and its red paint had all peeled away.

units.source_text: 要是等候来山涧的人，这座桥是绝好的地点。

en.t: If one were waiting for someone coming into the mountain ravine, this bridge was an excellent spot.
